title: Matrix in Slack
summary: Install Matrix in your Slack workspace and get answers grounded in your company's sources.

highlights.title: Matrix for Slack
highlights.body: Install the Matrix app in Slack and chat with Matrix there. Replies can draw on your company's sources, and work stays separated per company.

items.text: WhatsApp sign-up opens to more people in the EEA.
Bot model lists finish loading and can be retried.
Picking Matrix models and Gateway entries responds reliably.
Project sharing reports when it's ready again.
